why: Source: sum three profits, apply 10% uplift, sum three product counts, convert millions and divide (4 steps); question: the same four steps on the same layout of table, only the numbers differ.

Source: employees = (w+n)/160, items divided by employees, ignore the pay rate (3 steps); question: employees = (w+n)/38, orders divided by employees, ignore the pay rate r (3 steps).
